description: Guards against the classic failure modes when agents query the Storywrangler platform.

evals.name: dimensions-are-discovered-not-guessed
evals.failure_mode: Agent constructs a query with guessed ngram_size/granularity/entity values without consulting the registry.
evals.prompt: Compare 2-grams between the US and the UK on wikimedia for March 2025.
expected: Fetches dataset metadata (get-dataset or GET /registry/wikimedia/ngrams) before constructing the query
Validates ngram_size=2 against filter_values rather than assuming it exists
Checks manifest.availability covers March 2025 for both entities before querying
Resolves US/UK to entity IDs via the adapter or registry, not from memory

evals.name: empty-result-is-diagnosed-not-reported
evals.failure_mode: Agent receives an empty data array and tells the user the dataset is broken or the data is missing.
evals.prompt: I queried /wikimedia/top-ngrams and got an empty data array. Is the dataset broken?
expected: Checks the requested filter values against filter_values before concluding anything
Checks the requested date range against manifest.availability
Mentions that out-of-range filter values return empty results rather than errors
Only reports data as missing after ruling out filter/date/case mismatches

evals.name: term-case-is-preserved
evals.failure_mode: Agent lowercases or 'normalizes' the user's term, silently querying a different term.
evals.prompt: Show me the attention trend for COVID on English Wikipedia.
expected: Queries the term with the user's casing (COVID), not a lowercased variant
If the result is empty, tries obvious case variants and tells the user which casing matched

evals.name: figures-carry-their-provenance
evals.failure_mode: Agent produces a figure or number for a paper without recording which data and software versions produced it.
evals.prompt: Make the rank-turbulence divergence figure for our paper comparing US 2024 vs 2025.
expected: Records domain/dataset_id and dataset version alongside the output
Records the platform stack (GET /version: api, schemas, duckdb, allotax) or the meta block's dataset_version/allotax_version
Mentions comparing one axis at a time (same entity, two periods) as the interpretable design
